name: Divine Smite

casting_time.trigger: Taken immediately after you hit a target with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike.

summary: Right after a melee hit: the target takes an extra 2d8 Radiant damage (3d8 against Fiends and Undead).
text: Bonus Action, cast right after you hit a target with a Melee weapon or an Unarmed Strike. The strike flares with holy power and the target takes an extra 2d8 Radiant damage from it; the extra damage is 1d8 higher if the target is a Fiend or an Undead. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 1.
